name: codex-profiles
title: Codex Profiles
description: Switch ChatGPT between your local Codex profiles.
author: hamza_alchbli

commands.name: switch-profile
commands.title: Switch Profile
commands.subtitle: Work / Personal
commands.description: Open a separate ChatGPT window with its own local profile state.

commands.name: manage-profiles
commands.title: Manage Profiles
commands.description: Create, rename, and remove local Codex profiles.

commands.name: open-first-profile
commands.title: Switch to Profile 1
commands.subtitle: Required profile
commands.description: Open the required first profile directly; assign a Raycast hotkey for quick access.

commands.name: open-second-profile
commands.title: Switch to Profile 2
commands.subtitle: The next profile in the list
commands.description: Open the second profile directly; assign a Raycast hotkey for quick access.
